title: Command: check
lead:
`adj check QUERY` searches titles, keys, tags and decision text and reports
decided / open / not found.
findings_note: PROJECT.md Goals 6; v1 feature tier; Milestone 3

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 6: an agent asks "has X been decided?" before it asks the owner.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
End-to-end CLI tests call `cli.Run` in a fresh `t.TempDir()` store (with
`t.Chdir`, which rules out `t.Parallel`, or a root option the implementer adds
and records under C32), with a fixed clock where dates matter.

- Table-driven in `search_test.go`: a query matching a decided record reports
  `decided` with its ID; a query matching only open records reports `open` with
  their IDs; no match reports `not found`.
- One case each for a match on the title, the key, a tag and the decision text.
- Records that are rejected, withdrawn or superseded are handled by the rule
  the implementer records (proposed: they never count as decided).
- `check --json` is byte-identical across two runs and matches `docs/json.md`;
  the exit code for each result follows the recorded rule.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Implement the search in `query`. Implementer decides and records (C32): the
match rule (proposed: case-insensitive substring), what is reported when both
decided and open records match, and the exit code per result (proposed: 0 for
every completed search, with the result in the output).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Run from the repo root after `. scripts/env.sh` (the in-repo cache env, C33;
use the equivalent AGENTS.md names if S02 chose another):

- `go test ./...` passes, including this slice's new tests.
- `go vet ./...` reports nothing.
- `gofmt -l cmd internal` prints nothing (not `gofmt -l .`, which also walks
  `.cache/` and `.worktrees/`).
- Each interface choice made in this slice is a slicer catalog decision with a
  one-line reason (C32).
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
